issues: The hero was a grey placeholder card (grey bars and a dot) with nothing to read, plus the debug card name left in the corner
Light grey stage and grey card: no light, no colour, so all the impact rested on translation
Perspective and twist eased on the same curve as position, so the card was flat a few frames before arriving and the fisheye barely showed
The landing had only a 6px shake, no anime-style held accent, and the remaining 100f idled
changes: Aurora look (purple-black, violet, pink); the hero is a premiere card for a fictional streaming service, Hikari (1000×580): procedural neon-dusk artwork (striped sun, skyline, reflections), a 92px 'Neon Tide' title and a Watch now button

18f fling: translation −1350→0 on a snappy ease for the hard stop, while perspective 260→1800px, rotate3d 62°→0 and scale 1.8→1 resolve on a late curve, so the card arrives still twisted and is slapped flat in the last frames, a clear Kanada fisheye
Landing accent: rotateY overshoots to +6° and springs back, an 8px 2f shake, and 48 anime focus lines retreat outward over 9f; horizontal SpeedBlur plus 7 pink-white speed lines during flight
Follow-through: the card's text settles 3f late with the title straightening from a −10° skew, then the line 'Streams Friday · only on Hikari' rises word by word
Poster layout: a 168px low-opacity title band drifts slowly along the top, card centred, caption below; 120f total with a slow push in the tail
